composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_2 is striking a dense, heavy nodule of rusty red-brown ironstone with a heavy rock pick. The hard, metallic-looking mineral matrix cracks open cleanly to reveal a thick, spikes-covered armor tail plate from a Polacanthus dinosaur.
